rows.what_the_ink_shows: At the targeted later phrase, the scan reads "Y′=V(I), ces résultats, complétés par", with no intervening nous avons. See crops/58_scan030_H0480_resultats.png and crops/58_scan030_H0480_resultats_context.png. The initial of ces is a shallow open c, without a loop or an ascender (crops/58_scan030_H0480_word_detail.png). The later des in "la catégorie des" has a clear closed loop followed by a raised d stem (crops/58_scan030_H0480_des_comparison.png). Separately, the opening reads "nous avons vu", followed by deleted que and lorsque (crops/58_scan030_H0480_nous_avons.png). The full scan and all five tight, contrast-raised crops, enlarged to 2800–4300 pixels across, were inspected directly.
rows.note: The specifically supplied placement « nous avons des résultats, complétés par » is not on this page. The opening reads « nous avons vu », followed by deleted « que »; later, after Y′=V(I), the actual phrase is « ces résultats, complétés par ». At that later place the initial is a low, open c, unlike the looped, ascending d in the same-page comparison. This is an explicit exception to Michel Hua’s supplied check because the visible ink contradicts the proposed des at the only matching résultats phrase. Retain the original transcription. No alternative page location was verified; this is not classified as an authorial slip.
rows.main_resolution: Main reader independently inspected the full scan and opening, targeted phrase, word-detail and des-comparison crops. Decided d for the absent specifically quoted placement; the extant ces phrase is explicitly documented rather than silently relabeled as already satisfying the proposed des reading.
